title: Add authenticated member password change
decision: Implement POST /api/members/password using rune-count validation (8-16), existing bcrypt DefaultCost hashing, current-password verification, and DeleteByMemberID session invalidation.
reason: This preserves the existing authentication and response conventions while ensuring plaintext passwords are never persisted and previously issued sessions cannot continue after a credential change.
breakingImpact: The current session and all other sessions for the member become unauthorized after a successful password change; clients must log in again. No model fields were removed.
